Gouldian Finch

Source: vignettes/gouldian_finch.qmd

1 Introduction

This vignette guides you through the process of reproducing and analyzing occurrence data for the Gouldian Finch in Australia. The data is sourced from the Atlas of Living Australia (ALA), cleaned, enriched with weather information, and visualized.

2 Load Required Packages and Utilities

Required functions are included in vignette-utils.R, which you can load using:

organism_name = "gouldian_finch"
organism_title = "Gouldian Finch"

3 Data Analysis

We now explore the cleaned dataset in more detail.

4.3 Monthly Trends 

gouldian_finch |> plot_bar_month(legend = FALSE)

4.4 Yearly Trends 

gouldian_finch |> plot_bar_year(legend = FALSE)

gouldian_finch |> plot_monthly_occurrences_by_state()
gouldian_finch |> plot_weekly_occurrences_by_state()
gouldian_finch |> plot_seasonal_occurrence_polar()
gouldian_finch |> plot_monthly_occurrence_map()
gouldian_finch |> plot_monthly_occurrence_map_by_state()
gouldian_finch |> plot_monthly_distribution_map()

Work with Tourism dataset:

# make full tourism dataset
data("tourism_region")
data("tourism_quarterly")

tourism <- tourism_quarterly |>
  dplyr::left_join(tourism_region, by = "region_id") |> 
  dplyr::left_join(ecotourism::weather_stations, by = "ws_id")
# load top station for organism
data("top_stations")

top_stations_manta_rays <- top_stations |> filter(organism == "manta_rays")

No we can find related tourism spots

tourism |> filter(ws_id %in% top_stations_manta_rays$ws_id)

If you want to match quarter data use this code:

# 1. Aggregate manta observations to quarter
manta_quarter <- manta_rays %>%
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(date, "quarter")) %>%
  count(quarter, name = "manta_sightings")

# 2. Make sure tourism$quarter is also floor_date
tourism_clean <- tourism %>%
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(quarter, "quarter"))

# 3. Left join: keep all manta quarters, match tourism by quarter
manta_tourism <- manta_quarter %>%
  left_join(tourism_clean, by = "quarter")
